promptSpec: produce-mc — native prompt shown, target text picked. {promptNative, correct:TargetText, distractors:[3 TargetText], instruction} e.g. {"type":"produce-mc","promptNative":"to order (food in a restaurant)","correct":{"text":"pedir","reading":null},"distractors":[{"text":"pagar","reading":null},{"text":"probar","reading":null},{"text":"servir","reading":null}],"instruction":null,"itemIds":["i2"],"explanation":null}
rulesSpec: - produce-mc: exactly one of the four options may answer promptNative; if two would both do, rewrite the prompt. The closer the distractors sit to the correct target text without being a second right answer, the better the challenge.
paramsSpec: - words: how many words the native prompt in "promptNative" should have.
